## Materials

- 📝 [Template (.Rmd)](hw5/assignment5_blank.Rmd) — start here; the code is written, you interpret the results
- 📄 [Assignment (PDF)](hw5/assignment5_blank.pdf) — readable version of the questions, with the output
- 📊 [Data (assign3_data.csv)](hw5/assign3_data.csv) — same data as Assignments 3 and 4, Part B

This is a short assignment: two theory problems (20 points each) and ten results to interpret (6 points each).

## Instructions

Open the R Markdown template, knit it once to confirm your environment is set up, and complete each problem in the appropriate section. Submit a knitted PDF (and optionally the `.Rmd` source) via Canvas before the deadline.

::: {.callout-important}
Do not change the provided code. Knit once, read each result, and write your interpretation in the space below it.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Reproducibility
The template sets `set.seed(42)` for you, so your output should match the PDF.
:::
